<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum the upfield carbon signals (≈10–30 ppm) correspond to aliphatic carbons. The peaks at 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60 and 14.05 ppm are in the typical region for methyl carbons (CH₃). Assuming each distinct methyl carbon gives a separate signal, the molecule contains six methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
